messages:
Priya (Onboarding): Hey all — sending a quick check: I pushed the orientation invite for Wed 11/03 18:00 UTC but two folks said their calendar shows a different time and no passcode appeared. Anyone know the usual fixes? cc @calendar-helper-bot

calendar-helper-bot: Event created. ICS attached. Recording will be uploaded to Onboarding Drive.

Diego Ramos: I'm in Spain (CET) and my Outlook desktop shows 19:00 as expected, but a colleague in Japan saw 02:00 next day — they said the invite listed PST in the event header.

Priya (Onboarding): ah right. I made it from my laptop which is on PDT. Should I delete+recreate in UTC or change the event timezone?

Hana Liu: Recreate in UTC is lower risk. Also include the Zoom link AND numeric passcode in the description (Outlook sometimes strips join links in previews). Add a short "Local times" bullet list for PST/CET/JST/AEST.

IT Support: For Outlook you need VTIMEZONE blocks in the ICS or it can shift. If you export from Google Calendar, make sure the ICS includes VTIMEZONE/TZID entries.

Diego Ramos: Another helpful thing: publish the event and paste the "Add to calendar" links on the Notion onboarding page so people can pick their client. That avoids some ICS parsing issues.

Priya (Onboarding): Plan: I'll recreate the event set to UTC, paste Zoom URL + passcode in description, add local conversions, attach a verified ICS with TZ blocks, publish add-to-calendar links on Notion, and mark event as Busy. Will also add an "APAC note" telling overnight attendees to DM for a local ICS or recording.

Hana Liu: Please also pin the recording to Notion after the session. A few hires in EMEA couldn't access Drive last time due to ACLs.

IT Support: I can pre-grant the new-hires group read access to the Drive folder. Send the folder path after and I'll set perms.

Priya (Onboarding): Thanks — updating now. I'll post the new invite link + Notion page here when done. If anybody still sees timezone weirdness after that, reply with OS + timezone and I'll generate a hand-exported ICS for your zone.

Diego Ramos: :thumbsup:

calendar-helper-bot: Quick tip: create event with explicit TZ via gcalcli: `gcalcli add --when "2026-11-03 18:00" --duration 75 --title "Redwood Orientation" --description "Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/xxxx Passcode: 246810" --calendar "Onboarding"` then export the ICS and verify VTIMEZONE. Or via Google Calendar > More actions > Publish event > Add to calendar links.
